meta.title: Satellite SST, climatology and chlorophyll, Cyclone Amphan window, May 2020

climatology.days: the same calendar days, one a year

sources.sst: OSTIA reprocessed L4 foundation SST, 0.05 deg daily (Copernicus Marine SST_GLO_SST_L4_REP_OBSERVATIONS_010_011); each 0.5 deg cell the mean of the pixels inside it.
sources.clim: The mean of the same calendar day over 1991-2020 (30 OSTIA days for each analysis day).
sources.chl: Copernicus-GlobColour gap-free L4 daily multi-sensor chlorophyll-a, 4 km (OCEANCOLOUR_GLO_BGC_L4_MY_009_104); each cell the geometric mean of its pixels, where at least a quarter are defined. Gap-free means clouds are filled by interpolation.
sources.series: Each year 1982-2025, the mean OSTIA SST over the 8 analysis days in each box.

citations.text: E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information: Global Ocean OSTIA Sea Surface Temperature and Sea Ice Reprocessed (SST_GLO_SST_L4_REP_OBSERVATIONS_010_011), doi:10.48670/moi-00168. Good, S. et al. (2020), The current configuration of the OSTIA system for operational production of foundation sea surface temperature and ice concentration analyses, Remote Sens. 12, 720.

E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information: Global Ocean Colour (Copernicus-GlobColour), Bio-Geo-Chemical, L4 from Satellite Observations (OCEANCOLOUR_GLO_BGC_L4_MY_009_104), gap-free daily 4 km chlorophyll-a, doi:10.48670/moi-00281. Generated by ACRI-ST.

ostia.read: NetCDF-4 chunks in HTTPS byte ranges by data-pipeline/nc4.py
